_about: Documented differences between the experiment LOCK files and the package copies of the locked files. All other locked files (47/48 E38v2 preliminary, 49/50 E38v2 confirmatory, 78/80 E39, 64/65 E40) are byte-identical to the locked versions and are verified by scripts/L2_rerun_analysis.py. REDACTED: a public IP address was replaced by <PUBLIC_IP_REDACTED> in an operator runbook (documentation, not executed by the analysis); lock_sha256 is the hash of the original (unredacted) file as recorded in the LOCK, package_sha256 the hash of the package copy. WITHHELD: artefact not redistributed (compiled binary / third-party wheel bundle); its hash remains in the LOCK.
